- [RLOW.3.3.3] The schema's metadata, carried by its lifecycle atom and its
  `Slot` atoms rather than by a record of its own: the lifecycle and, for a
  `ttl` schema, the default TTL ([RDSC.5.3], [RDSC.5.4]); per slot, its
  identity role on a `logical` schema ([RLOW.3.6.1]), its tolerance
  ([RLOW.3.7.1]) and its `sampled` / `retained` markers ([RLOW.3.5])
  ([RDSC.5.5]).
